Commentary.Commentary: The hosts looked deflated and devoid of any kind of inspiration with the pink cherry. When there wasn't much assistance for the bowlers, they should have applied the pressure and then bought the wickets through that. But instead, gave up and were essentially just waiting for time to tick along. Yasir Shah, like he has been for his side, was the only saving grace in their performance. He ended up with 6 scalps but had to work really hard for it. Now, with the ball gripping and turning, and the Islanders having two proper spinners in their ranks, the task will be a difficult one to say the least. Let's see how they fare under lights. Don't go anywhere, play will resume shortly...

Sri Lanka have finished with a big first innings total on the board. For the most part of the game, the visitors dominated proceedings with the bat. Dimuth Karunaratne was the focal point of it all as he stuck around and took all the bite out of the Pakistan bowling attack. He was unfortunate to miss out on a double ton, but nevertheless, did his job. Was part of 5 good partnerships, the most notable of them being the one with his skipper. The 146-run stand was the pillar of this innings and it ultimately saw the Lankans cruise to a total close to 500.

OUT! That does it! Typical leg spinner's dismissal. Tossed up on middle and leg, spins a shade as Pradeep brings his bat around his pad to defend. It takes the edge and flies straight into the hands of Asad Shafiq at second slip, who gobbles it up with ease. SRI LANKA ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 482!
Flighted on the stumps, swept away through mid-wicket. Single taken as the fielder in the deep mops it up.
Similar to what happened on the previous delivery. It's a length ball outside off, Pradeep plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Holds its line outside off, he plays inside the line and ends up getting beaten past the outside edge.
Good length ball just around off, Pradeep with a solid defensive shot presented off the back foot.
Cutting back in from around off, Pradeep stays back and meets it with a straight bat.
Short of a good length angling into the body, pulled along the ground to deep square leg. One run added to the total.
Bumper angling across, Herath is watchful as he lets the ball sail over his head.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, with some turn and bounce, the left-hander misses the reverse sweep and the keeper fails to collect as well. This allows the batsmen to steal a bye.
Fraction straight in line, swept fine towards short fine leg. No run taken.
Googly around off, Rangana is down to sweep but misses it altogether.

FOUR! Just back of a driving length as it's pitched outside off, Herath connects the reverse sweep well as he beats the man at short third man. Nobody out there in the deep so the ball will run away to the boundary line.

Starts the over from around the wicket, drops it around off and it spins in sharply. Going down in fact, Herath kneels down to sweep but misses. There's a shout for a caught behind, nothing from the umpire though.
Well outside off, Pradeep has nothing to do with that one.
Keeps it full again, around off, good line. Pradeep can only defend.
Fuller in length, outside the line of off stump, Rangana Herath with a drive through the covers. It earns him an easy single.
Connects this time, cuts it away square on the off side but finds the fielder.
On a length again, in that off stump channel, Herath plays for it but misses.
Shaping away from around off, Herath looks to cut but misses.
Nuwan Pradeep is the last man in for Sri Lanka.

OUT! 5-fer for Yasir Shah! His 13th in Test match cricket. Some good piece of bowling from him again. Seeing Gamage give the charge, he fires it wide outside off. Sarfraz has a lot of time to take the bails off and he does so, while the batsman attempts to get back in. Replays confirm that Lahiru is indeed gone and that's one more wicket down.
A stumping decision against Lahiru Gamage is referred upstairs by the umpire.

Loud shout for an lbw, declined instantly! The big stride saved him and the impact was probably outside off too. Full around off with not much turn, Gamage lunges ahead to block but is caught on the front pad. Nothing from the umpire though, good decision in the end.
A bit fuller than Yasir would have liked, the ball as a result doesn't turn much and it's defended into the track.
Switches the angle for Gamage, it's flat and quick on middle and leg, defended down on the leg side with soft hands.
Landed outside off, Rangi drags the sweep and places it down towards fine leg for a single.
Looped up from around the wicket, outside off, Herath plants his front foot forward and defends it off the inner half past the short leg fielder.
Moves a step across, gets behind the line and defends it with the full face of the bat.
Length ball around off, keeps slightly low and beats the batsman for pace too. He looks to force it away on the off side but fails to make connect.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Attempted yorker which just misses. It tails back in and Gamage takes it on the full. Only manages a drive as far as the cover fielder.
Outside off on a good length, no trouble for Gamage to let it be.
Fuller length delivery on off, Gamage with a solid front foot defense.
Dipping and turning into Rangana Herath, he looks to tickle it but it goes off the inner edge down the leg side.
Outside off on a fuller length, reverse swept by Herath. Finds the fielder at point so no run taken.
The batsman has played it to the point region. They pick up a single.
Turning in on off, swept away through square leg for a single.

He did not pick that up at all! Ripper from Yasir Shah. Wrong 'un around off, Herath is forward to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes right between the keeper and first slip. Two runs are taken.
Spinning in from outside off, Herath moves across his sticks to meet the ball with his bat, but instead, does it with his thigh pad.
The debutant, LAHIRU GAMAGE, is the next man in.

OUT! Lakmal is gone! Abbas gets another wicket to his name. Length delivery tailing back in, catches Lakmal on the pads as he misses his flick. Loud shout and after some thought, the umpire's finger goes up. The Lankan pacer reviews it as he think it might be angling down. It's taken upstairs and replays show that the ball is hitting leg stump. So three reds and he's gone.

Suranga Lakmal is caught leg before and adjudged out by umpire Richard Kettleborough. The batsman has, however, decided to review it and so it's taken upstairs. Looks close, let's see what happens now.
Short in length again, Lakmal goes back and pulls it hard, finds the mid-wicket fielder this time.
On the shorter side of the length again, Lakmal meets it with a straight blade in defense.
Just back of a length very close to the off stump, kept out down on the track from within the crease.
FOUR! Dropped short and Lakmal has made him pay! On middle stump, Lakmal rocks back and with a little swivel muscles the pull over mid-wicket for a one-bounce boundary.
Good length delivery on the sixth stump line, Lakmal seeing the room looks to cut it away. The inward movement though cramps him and hence, it goes off the inside edge and falls next to him.
Around the wicket to Rangi, the southpaw plays the reverse sweep towards point. Straight to the fielder so no run taken.
Leans ahead a touch and knocks it down towards long off for one.
Works it off his pads and places it away on the on side.

Big swing and a big miss! Yasir tosses it up on the stumps, Suranga Lakmal in an attempt to clear Dubai, swings wildly across the line. Doesn't connect with anything but thin air as the ball goes over the stumps.
Tad quicker, flatter and outside off, pushed away into the off side for nothing.
Quicker one on middle stump, turning a bit as well, Suranga goes deep inside the crease and blocks it right under his nose.
Speared wide, very wide. The batsman can't get to it.
Rolls his fingers over this and takes some pace off it, Herath fails to guide it down to third man as he's quite early into the shot.
Just ahead of a length and outside off, Herath looks to play the expansive drive but gets it off the inner half back down towards mid off.
Makes connection this time. Cuts it sweetly but finds the man at point.
Another one wide outside off, another flash and another miss.
Length delivery angled way across, Herath throws his bat at that, only to connect with thin air.
The batsman goes after this one but misses the line completely.
Quite full on the stumps, Lakmal looks to flick but closes the face too early. Spoons a leading edge which falls safely at mid-wicket.
Googly on middle and off, the batsman goes back and works it on the leg side.
Some good turn again, outside off, Lakmal misses another attempt to get some bat on it.
Floats it right up there, on middle and off, kept out off the front foot.
Lovely tossed up delivery outside off, Lakmal is forward to defend but is beaten by the turn past the outside edge.
Short ball around off and middle, pulled away to fine leg for one run.
Similar delivery around off, driven to covers.
Pitched further up outside off, Lakmal smashes it through covers where Yasir dives and saves a certain boundary. Riaz hugs him for the effort.
On a length outside off, the ball nips in a bit. Lakmal gets an inside edge onto his pads as he pushes at it from the crease.
A tad fuller around middle and leg, pushed off the front foot to mid on.
Length delivery outside off, cut away through point for one run.
ABBAS to bowl.
Loopy ball around off, Herath gets an inside edge onto his pads towards covers for a run.
Flatter around middle, flicked away round the corner.
This ball is swept to square leg.
Loopy ball around off spinning in, Herath misses the sweep and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up ball around off, spins down the leg side. Herath leaves it alone.
Begins with a loopy ball outside off, Herath prods forward in defense, gets an inside edge next to short leg.

The men who matter walk out to the middle. Herath and Lakmal will walk to resume their innings with the bat. For Pakistan, Yasir Shah will start off the proceedings with the ball. A slip and a short leg in place.
DAY 2, SESSION THREE...

The hosts' body language has just not been positive. They have offered free runs on many occasions and just not looked threatening. With Amir out with an injury, they have got a setback even before the match reaches the halfway stage. Yasir Shah restored some pride for them by picking up his fourth wicket. Unless something drastically changes, expect the next session to pan the same way. Join us in a while for the resumption.

Sri Lanka all the way! They continue to dominate the game. The seeds to this tall score were sown by Karunaratne, who was really unlucky to not get to a deserving double ton. Of course, that's how sport is, but that innings just deflated the Pakistan fielders to no end. Adding salt to injury were Dickwella and Perera, who notched up their respective fifties.
Flatter around off, Lakmal gets it off the inside half of his bat towards square leg. That's DINNER, DAY 2!
Stays back and punches it to covers for a single.
Flatter around off, punched to mid-wicket off the back foot.
Loopy ball around middle, driven to long on for a run.
This is landed around off, tuned away to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball around off and middle, Herath paddles it fine towards fine leg for a run.
Flatter and quicker around off and middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
This delivery is tapped in front of point for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy ball around off, Herath looks to sweep but misses. The ball strikes him on the thigh.
This ball around off and middle is defended off the front foot.
The ball has struck the batsman hard on his hand.
Outside off, cut away through point for a run.
Shorter outside off, Herath looks to cut but misses.
Quicker outside off, guided towards the short third man fielder.
Herath sweeps this but finds the fielder at square leg.
Lakmal gets off the mark, as he drives this to long on.
Flatter in line of the stumps, punched back towards the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, padded away by Rangana.
Well outside off, left alone.
Floated around off, Herath looks to sweep. The ball lobs off his arms and flies towards short leg. The keeper attempts to catch that but fails. No bat there anyway.
Googly outside off, Herath plays for the turn but the ball spins away from the bat, beating the edge.
This one is blocked off the front foot.

Rangana is watching and would love it, despite he being at the batting end! Shah tosses it up outside off, the ball spins a mile and the keeper collects it moving to his right. Herath watches the ball, offering no shot.
Flatter in line of the stumps, Lakmal gets forward and blocks.
Similar delivery, Suranga defends it off the front foot.
Sohail gives some more air to that, Lakmal lunges forward and defends.
Rangana plays this through covers for a run.
Herath looks to sweep that but misses.
Loopy delivery around off and middle, defended off the front foot, showing the full face of the bat.
The next man in for Sri Lanka is SURANGA LAKMAL.

OUT! Timber from behind the legs! Shah tosses this down the leg side, Perera lunges forward and looks to block. He fails to cover the line of the ball and ends up missing the ball completely. The ball pitches in the rough besides the batsman's leg and spins in to rattle the woodwork behind. End of a good knock from Perera. Yasir gets his fourth!
This ball is blocked off the front foot.
Tosses it around leg, Perera again pads it away. The ball takes the pad and goes to the slip fielder.
Pitched outside leg, Perera pads this away.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! And Perera continues collecting boundaries! Shah fired it short around leg, Dilruwan goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Loopy ball outside off, Rangana pads it away.
This one outside off is left alone.
Loopy ball in line of the stumps, defended off the front foot.
This ball is defended off the back foot.
Quicker outside off, Herath looks to glide it to third man but misses.
Tossed up ball well outside off, Herath watches the ball go into the keeper's gloves.
Tossed up delivery around off and middle, slog swept away towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
This spun sharply! Beats Herath's bat and strikes him on the pads.
Very full loopy ball around off, Herath reverse paddles it through the vacant slip region for a brace.
This ball is driven through covers for one run.
Herath sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Loopy ball outside off, driven through covers for a run.
Sohail bangs it short in line of the stumps, Perera looks to pull but gets a top edge that lands in no man's land. The long off fielder gets there. The batsman run one.
Punched off the back foot to covers.
Floated around off, reverse swept through backward point for one run.
Shortish around off, Perera goes back and pulls it to long on for a run.
This delivery is clipped off his pads to mid-wicket.
Flat on the pads, flicked away through square leg for one run.
Floated outside off, Perera edges it on the bounce to slip.
A tad shorter outside off, cut away to point.
This ball outside off is pushed to covers, where the fielder slides to stop that.
Flighted ball around off, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
This is well outside off, left alone.
Turn and bounce! Shah loops it up around off, the ball spins to beat the bat of Perera, who had lunged forward in defense.
YASIR SHAH to bowl another spell now.
Serves it outside off, Herath leaves it alone.
6th Test fifty for Perera! How well has he played for that! He knocks it to long on to get to a run that takes him to fifty.
In line of the stumps, swept away through square leg for a run.
Perera taps this towards mid-wicket and sets off for a run. Sohail himself goes and fields that.
Strides forward and defends it off the front foot.
Flatter ball outside off, it stayed a tad low. Perera edges that and it goes on the bounce to Azam at slip.
Length ball around off, tapped towards covers for a run.
Very full ball on the pads, Herath misses the flick and wears it on the pads. A huge appeal ensues, but the umpire stays put. The batsmen steal a leg bye. That would have gone down the leg.
Outside off, driven through point for a run.
Back of a length, pulled away in front of square on the leg side for a quick run. Russel Arnold, on-air, quips that this is the fastest he has run for a while!
Change of socks for Wahab Riaz.
This one is flicked off his pads through mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball outside off, Perera gets beaten as he looks to push that.
In line of the stumps, swept away past backward square leg for one run.
Herath flicks it through mid-wicket for a run to get off the mark.
Floated outside off, Herath looks to cut but misses.
This is punched through covers for one run.
This ball is defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Perera looks to sweep that but gets it off his pads towards square leg.
RANGANA HERATH is the next man in.

OUT! The tentativeness has caused Karunaratne his wicket! It had been a good knock till this moment but now that's it. Riaz bowls it on a length around off, Karunaratne pokes his bat at it and ends up chopping the ball onto his back thigh and then onto his stumps. He played so, so well till then but started looking uncharacteristically tentative and quiet as he neared the landmark. Fatigue might have got to him as he ended up losing his concentration, which proved to be fatal. But despite all that... Well played, Dimuth Karunaratne! You've done a fine job.
On a length around middle and leg, knocked to mid-wicket.
This is defended from within the crease.
A low full toss outside off is driven through cover-point for a run.
Fuller on the pads, worked away to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery down the leg side, Dimuth lets that go to the keeper.
Tossed up on middle and off, blocked.
Leans into the full ball and drives it to mid off for a single.
The batsman dances down the track and hits it to mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flat and short around off, Dimuth offers a firm punch towards mid on and scurries through for a quick run.
Straighter in line again, it's nudged on the on side. No run taken though.
Quicker and flatter on middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
Stays right behind the line and guards it out with a straight blade.
Lands it in the channel outside off, Perera plays inside the line and as a result, is beaten past the outside edge.
Outside off on a good length, from around the wicket, Perera attempts to have a poke at it but fails to do so.
Angling back in on middle and leg, tucked square on the leg side for a single.
Length ball just outside off, keeps a little low as Karunaratne dabs it square to point.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Dimuth leans across a touch and works it to the man at mid-wicket.
Drinks are on the field now!
Similar delivery and sequence of actions.
Flighted ball around off, blocked off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This ball is tuned to mid-wicket.
Landed in line of the stumps, defended off the front foot.
Begins with a slow loopy ball in line of the stumps, looks to sweep but misses.
HARIS SOHAIL is brought in to bowl.
Full ball around middle and leg, flicked towards square leg.
Fuller this time, pushed towards point.
Back of a length delivery, Karunaratne clips it off his hips. Ahmed dives to his right and makes a stop. Now, Wahab Riaz is officially warned by the umpire for stepping on the danger area repeatedly.
Lands it on a length around off, Dimuth stays put in the crease and pushes it towards covers. Wants a run initially but changes his mind later.
On a length outside off, Perera square-drives it to deep backward point for one run.
Comes round the wicket and lands it on a length around middle and off. Perera stays in his crease and blocks that.
This is flicked off his pads to square leg.
A tad short outside off, cut away towards point. A diving attempt by the fielder there restricts the batsmen to one.
Pushed back towards the bowler.

FOUR! Dilruwan Perera is a dealer... He deals in boundaries! This is tossed up outside off, he gets his foot to the pitch of the ball and drives it through covers. The fielder chasing came second best. Also brings up the 50-run stand between these two.
Floated ball around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one run.
Lands it in line of the stumps, defended from the crease.
Full inswinging low full toss around middle, clipped towards wide mid on for a run.
Length ball outside off, pushed to point.
Around off, Dimuth bunts it off the front foot.

As Wahab Riaz is bowling over the wicket, he is seen treading in the danger area yet again. Then the camera shows Rangana Herath, who is seen smiling after spotting Riaz's replay. The former might surely be happy with this, as he would have more rough to play with.
This ball is clipped off his pads to square leg.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Length ball around off, played from within the crease.
WAHAB RIAZ is brought on for a spell.
FOUR! Straight as an arrow! Yasir Shah tosses this up in line of the stumps, Perera gets to the pitch and just hits it straight over the bowler's head for a boundary.
A tad shorter around off and middle, Perera looks to pull but ends up getting a bottom edge onto his pads.
Flicked through mid-wicket for one run.

NOT OUT! Well run! Tossed up ball around middle and leg, Perera charges down a bit and flicks it towards mid on and sets off for a run. Azhar Ali collects it and hits the bull's eye at the bowler's end. The third umpire is called for. Replays do confirm that Perera has made it in with ease.
There's a direct hit at the bowler's end for a run out. The umpire has gone upstairs. Looks to be close.
Loopy ball around middle, Dimuth charges down and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Karunaratne charges down and plays it back to the bowler.
Perera evades the bouncer by ducking under it.
Fuller delivery outside off, Dilruwan drives it through cover-point for a couple.
On the pads, flicked away through square leg for a run.
Very full delivery outside off, Karunaratne looked to dig it out but missed.
Bowled outside off, punched towards covers for a run.

FOUR! Roshan Abeysinghe informs us that Perera debuted as an opener, and this shot is an ample proof of the reason! A shot that any top order batsman would be proud of. It was on a length outside off, Dilruwan took a stride forward and caressed it through covers for a boundary.
Flatter quicker ball around off, Perera is hurried on as he goes back to cut. Gets it towards point for a run. But the players appeal thinking it to be pad first.
Beautiful spin bowling. Shah tosses it around off, Perera lunges forward to block but the ball spins away past the edge of the bat.
Floated around middle, whipped away using the wrists through wide mid on for a brace.
FOUR! Short, punished! Yasir bowls it around off, spinning away from Perera. He goes deep in the crease and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Now this is Karunaratne's highest Test score! Flatter around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one run.
Serves it in line of the stumps, defended off the front foot by Dimuth!

Well kept, Sarfraz! It was a fullish ball outside off, in a bid to guide it to third man, Perera gets a bottom edge that goes on the bounce to the right of the keeper. He puts in the dive and prevents a certain boundary.
This is around off, Dilruwan plays it to point from the crease.
Equals his Test best score! On a length around middle and leg, Karunaratne taps it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Abbas lands it a tad short around off, Perera shifts his body weight back and pulls it through mid-wicket for three runs.
Perera blocks this length delivery off the front foot.
FOUR! Flashes and flashes hard! Length delivery outside off, Perera has enough room to free his arms. Slashes at it and the ball flies past the lone slip fielder for a boundary to third man.
On the pads, flicked to square leg.
Perera is enticed with the loopy ball and he drives it through covers. The batsmen get three before Azam retrieves the ball.
Bunts it off the front foot onto the ground.
Floated around middle, Karunaratne charges down and flicks it through mid-wicket. A slight misfield there allows him a run.
Tossed up ball around off, Dimuth allows it to turn and pushes it to covers.
Serves it around middle and leg, turned away off the inside half of the bat towards backward square leg for a run.
Length ball outside off, punched towards covers for a run.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Dilruwan ducks under that and lets it pass.
This delivery is bunted off the front foot.
Landed in line of the stumps, Perera blocks it off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, cut towards point for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.

FOUR! Well, Perera maybe a lower order batsman, but he's not going to hold himself back in this run-fest! Sees the tossed up ball around middle and leg, charges down the ground and hits it over mid on for a boundary.
Flatter on the pads, flicked in front of square on the leg side for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A tad shorter outside off, cut past backward point for a brace.
Googly around off and middle, Karunaratne goes back in the crease and looks to clip it away. Ends up getting an outer edge towards backward point.
Loopy ball around middle, pushed to mid on.
This ball is pushed towards mid-wicket. A wicket-maiden for Abbas!

Almost chopped on! Length delivery outside off, Perera looks to play it to the off side. The ball strikes the inner half and bounces towards the stumps. Dilruwan is alert and shoves the ball just off the stumps.
A short ball at 126 kph, Perera crouches under that and lets it go.
Similar delivery around off and middle, defended off the front foot.
Fuller delivery around off, met with a forward defense from Perera.
DILRUWAN PERERA is the next batsman for Sri Lanka. A slip in place for him.

OUT! A wicket against the run of play! And it's a really soft dismissal. Abbas lands it on a length outside off, Dickwella looks to play that away from the body. The ball nips back in a touch to take the inside edge en route the keeper's gloves. End of an enterprising knock from the diminutive keeper-batsman. Abbas gets rewarded, finally. Will this wicket spur up the home side to run through the opposition?
Shah loops it around off, Niroshan goes back and taps it towards covers for a quick single.
Punched down to long on for a run.
Floated around off, Dickwella goes back and guides it towards third man for a run.
Tossed up ball outside off, Niroshan looks to sweep but gets hit on the pads.
This is fired on the pads, clipped away through square leg for a single.
Serves a flatter quicker ball outside off, the ball stays a tad low, thereby missing the cut shot attempted by Karunaratne.
A tad fuller in line of the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket for a run.
An off cutter slower ball outside off, Karunaratne looks to run it to third man but misses. It goes on the bounce to Ahmed.
Similar delivery and sequence of actions. A dot ball, the result.
Comes over the wicket and serves it fuller outside off, the batsman knocks it towards covers.
FOUR! Freebies for Karunaratne, something that he loves dearly! Abbas lands this on the pads, all Dimuth has to do is get bat to that. He does and clips it through fine leg for a boundary.
Abbas comes round the wicket and sprays it around middle and leg. Karunaratne clips it away through square leg for a brace.
MOHAMMAD ABBAS to start from the other end.
This is swept to square leg for nothing.

7th Test fifty for Niroshan Dickwella! What a knock it has been - a quickfire one! He's taken the bull by its horns from the moment he has walked in. Coming to the ball, it was just outside off, guided towards third man for a brace.
Shah floats it around middle, Dimuth turns it through mid-wicket for a run.
Shortish ball outside off, cut away through point for a run.
Bad news, folks! The on-air commentators inform us that Mohammad Amir has gone for an MRI scan.
Loopy ball around off, Dickwella goes deep and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Begins with a shortish ball outside off, Dickwella stays in the crease and hits it straight to the cover fielder.

The players and the umpires walk out to the middle. This could be a moving session, in the sense that, the Lankans would play for declaration or we could see a flurry of wickets. Karunaratne and Dickwella will resume their innings. Yasir Shah to start the proceedings with the pink cherry. A short leg in place. Let's roll...
DAY 2, SESSION TWO...

Pakistan were anything from bad to worse in this session. Their bowlers were unable to maintain any kind of rhythm, complicating matters for their skipper. Add to that an off-colour Wahab Riaz, who bowled almost an 8-minute over - things look uphill for them as they stand. On top of that, their premier speedster, Amir, is struggling with a niggle and has been off field for some time now. The hosts would hope that this is a break which would help them regroup and recoup and come back strong. Do join us in a while for the second phase of play.

101 runs in this session, shows which side the see-saw has tilted. Sri Lanka continued inflicting misery on the hosts as they punished the bowlers. Karunaratne and Chandimal continued belting runs before the latter was dismissed LBW. He got a rough deal as the ball would have missed the stumps, as seen in the replays. But from the moment Dickwella walked in, he has been on a run-scoring spree, being severe especially on the spinners. Along with the opener, he has kept the Lankans on course for a strong total first-up.
Fired down the leg side, Karunaratne misses the flick. The ball kisses the pads and lands in the keeper's gloves. That's TEA, DAY 2!
This one is flicked round the corner from he crease.
WIDE! Very wide ball outside off, Dimuth doesn't bother playing that. Wide signaled.
Lands it around leg, turned to mid-wicket.
Around off, driven towards covers.
In line of the stumps, front foot defense on display.
Wide down the leg side, No trouble at all for the batsman.

This is what Wahab is capable of! Hurls in a very full quick delivery, Karunaratne misses the flick and gets it off his pads. A leg bye taken. Pakistan put in a stifled appeal to no avail. Hawk Eye confirms that the ball wasn't even close to the stumps.
Now comes from over the wicket and bowls it outside off, Dickwella collects a single for a run.

Now again Riaz had to abort his run up! Before you start thinking, this time it is because the batsman has an issue with the sightscreen! among all these aborted run ups, Ahmed behind the stumps has done numerous squats!
On a length around off, dabbed in front of point for a single.
Fuller ball around off, Niroshan guides it to third man for a single.
Bangs a bouncer, Dickwella ducks in response.

FOUR! Riaz steams in from round the wicket and spears it full outside off. Dickwella drives it off the outer half of his bat past the leaping fielder. The ball teasingly races away even as the fielder from covers rushes there.
Darted full on leg, this time Dimuth manages to pad it away.
Wide! Down the leg side, Dimuth looks to pad it away but misses. Wide called by the umpire, probably because of the warning given to Shafiq from yesterday for bowling negatively too frequently.
Short and quick, pitched outside off, Dickwella with a firm punch to the cover area for a single.
Flat and a tad shorter around off, punched into the covers for nothing.
Stands tall and punches this one down to long off for one.
Over the wicket now, it's landed outside leg and it's turning. Karunaratne looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards point.
Off spinner around off from around the wicket, not much turn on it though. Dickwella backs away and punches it past the cover fielder for a single.
Riaz bangs in a short ball in line of the stumps, Karunaratne ducks and lets that go. The bowler tumbles as he bowls that.
Short ball around middle, pulled to mid-wicket.
This is around off, tapped towards covers for a quick run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Now balls a full ball around middle and leg, Dickwella plays it from the crease.
Short ball again around off, similar response from Niroshan.
Wahab runs in from round the wicket and bowls a bouncer around middle and off. ND sways away and lets that go.
This delivery on the pads is flicked towards mid-wicket.
Lands this around middle and off, blocked off the front foot.
Another delivery on the pads, worked away round the corner for one run.
This is worked off his pads for a run through square leg.
This one is down the leg side and the batsman leaves it alone.
Fires this around off, Dickwella paddles it to fine leg for a run. Stifled appeal by the keeper as he thinks it hit the pad.
ASAD SHAFIQ to roll his arm over now.
This ball is played through point for a brace. End of the nelson over, which had almost 11 attempts to bowl!
And finally, Riaz delivers the ball! Bangs a short ball around off, Karunaratne sways away and lets that go.

Twice in quick succession, Riaz has missed his run up. He runs to the bowling mark and aborts. As I write this, he does it for the third time! Pakistan's coach Mickey Arthur is seen covering his eyes, not able to believe what's happening out there. And again! Fourth consecutive time! This time he leaps and then aborts bowling that. Meanwhile, as Riaz re-marks his run up, Sarfraz Ahmed catches a drinks break. The commentators on-air are unable to believe the fact that the bowler is losing his rhythm in the middle of the spell. Mind you, WAHAB RIAZ RUNS IN AND ABORTS FOR THE FIFTH TIME! He has almost run an over all by himself! Unbelievable! It's not what you expect from a senior bowler in the side!
Short ball around off, pulled to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length on the pads, flicked away through backward square leg for one run.
Now defends this ball with a full face of the bat off the front foot.

FOUR! Hello Wahab, says Niroshan with a boundary! Riaz runs in and spears a length delivery outside off, Dickwella stands tall and smashes it through covers for a boundary. How easy he makes batting look!
WAHAB RIAZ is back into the attack another spell. Should use his experience to somehow stem the runflow and get them some wickets.
Flatter ball around leg, clipped through square leg for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flatter on the pads, worked away to short fine leg.
Wonderful use of the feet. Shah lands it flatter around middle, Dickwella makes room and slaps it through covers. Azhar Ali rushes from mid off and keeps the batsmen down to three.
Loopy ball around leg, Niroshan charges down and looks to work it to the on side, but gets a leading edge to the off side.
Yasir comes from over the wicket and serves a flat ball on the pads, Dickwella flicks it to square leg.
The batsmen are having a change of gloves. Meanwhile, thinking about the threat of the reverse sweep, Pakistan have two fielders manning the boundary deep on the off side.
On a length in line of the stumps, defended from the crease.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Abbas lands it full outside off, Karunaratne drives it wide of mid off. Ali rushes there, puts in the dive but fails to stop the ball and it races away for a boundary.
Short ball around leg, Niroshan looks to pull but gets it off the bottom half of his bat to fine leg for a run.
Fuller delivery outside off, Niroshan mistimes his drive towards covers.
Another short delivery around leg, pulled away to deep square leg for a run.
Slow short ball down the leg side, Dickwella swivels and pulls it to fine leg for a run.
Shah fires it short, Dickwella stays in the crease and pulls it to deep square leg for a run. Ahmed is heard yelling from behind the stumps. His frustrations get evident with every passing ball.

Loopy ball around off, Karunaratne charges down and drives it straight back. Yasir gets some hand onto that and the ball deflects onto the stumps at his end. But the ball goes towards covers post that, enabling the batsmen to run one.
A tad short outside off, slapped through covers for a single.
This ball is flicked off his pads to deep backward square leg for one run.
Loopy ball around off, Niroshan taps it towards covers and sets off for a run. Yasir runs to get the ball but the batsmen complete the run easily.
Yasir goes wide of the crease and bowls a googly outside off. Dickwella stays in the crease and cuts it to the fielder at point.

FOUR! Well-driven. And he wouldn't miss out on these the way he is playing! Abbas spears it full around middle and off, Karunaratne shows the full face of the bat and drives it down the ground for a boundary.
On a length around off, bunted to the off side from within the crease.
Full delivery outside off, Dickwella hits it to covers and takes a quick run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
This delivery is clipped to square leg for no run.
Abbas lands it on a length around middle and leg, defended from the crease.
Length delivery on the pads, flicked through square leg for one run.
MOHAMMAD ABBAS back on for another spell. We are seeing Amir going off the field. Hopefully, he hasn't done great damage to himself and we see him back soon.
This delivery is worked down the leg side for a single.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Dimuth looks to reverse sweep that but misses.
Tossed up outside off, Karunaratne charges down and blocks it.
Now Niroshan sweeps this off his stumps, through backward square leg for a run.
Flatter and quicker down the leg side, Niroshan looks to flick it but misses. Needs to bowl more of these.

Sarfraz is seen having a chat with Yasir. The talk might be about bowling the right lines as per the field. They have a 7-2 leg side field. Also, to bowl quicker should be the plan in order to give less time for the batsmen to play.

FOUR! Risky but effective! The dimunitive batsman is intent on attacking the spinner. Shah tosses this around off, Dickwella reverse sweeps it aerially over backward point for a boundary. Probably the leg side heavy field might have made him play this shot.
Karunaratne plays this delivery from within the crease.
Length delivery outside off, punched towards covers.
This ball around off is defended off the front foot onto the ground.
A tad fuller around middle, Dickwella clips it through mid-wicket. Before the fielder retrieves the ball, the batsmen get back for three. 300 up for Sri Lanka!
During the drinks break, the physio was seen tending to Amir's shin. Seems like that was what troubled him yesterday.
FOUR! Imperious against pace too! It is full outside off, Dickwella times the cover drive perfectly. The ball beats the dive from the mid off fielder and races away to the fence.
Fuller delivery in line of the stumps, Karunaratne clips it through backward square leg for a run.

Drinks have been taken! Sri Lanka's hour yet again. Although they lost the sole wicket of Chandimal, Karunaratne has carried from where he left last night and has crossed 150 yet again. Pakistan seem to have run out of ideas to dismiss him and sometimes they look like going through the motions. They would look to restrict the batsmen to as less as possible now.
FOUR! Make no mistake, Dickwella absolutely treats the spinners with disdain. Period. Yasir tosses this up, the diminutive batsman charges down and smashes it over mid-wicket for a boundary.

150 for Karunaratne, his third score in the 150s! Shah serves a loopy ball around off, Dimuth looks to defend it off his front foot but the extra bounce makes the ball take the inside edge, hit his pads and lob past short leg. He takes a single that takes him to the milestone. Soaks in all the applause that he gets and deserves.
Floated outside off, Dimuth reverse sweeps it to backward point.
This delivery in line of the stumps is flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Loopy delivery around off, Dickwella looks to sweep but gets it off the top edge through backward square leg for a run.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Dickwella charges down and drives it through covers for a brace. Stresses the fact that how good he is against spin.
On a length outside off, Dimuth stays in the crease and bunts it.
Serves it around off, Niroshan taps it towards covers for a run.
Two slips in place now. Ramiz Raja quips on-air that they are thankful for that field change, which he had wanted from ball one of this over.
Aah! Beauty from Amir! Lands it on a good length outside off, Dickwella looks to push at it from the crease but misses. The ball passes close to the outside edge of his bat.
Amir bowls it around off, ND defends it off his front foot towards covers.
Length delivery outside off, pushed to point from the crease.
Spears it on a length outside off, Niroshan flays at that but misses.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Dickwella gets going straightaway with a sweep. He collects a run after playing it through backward square leg.
Explosive wicketkeeper-batsman NIROSHAN DICKWELLA walks in to replace his captain at the crease.

OUT! The leg spinner strikes to provide a big breakthrough! Yasir Shah bowls a flatter and straighter delivery around off, Chandimal offers his pad to that instead of the bat. The ball strikes the pad and he looks a dead duck. The players appeal and the umpire upholds the appeal. The Lankan skipper doesn't bother reviewing that as he knows he makes a cardinal sin there. That ends a good 146-run stand. But hang on, Hawk Eye shows that the ball would have gone on to miss the stumps! My goodness! It looked like a straighter delivery but the technology showed it to spin a bit and miss the stumps. Going by it, Pakistan could count themselves lucky to get away with that.
Tossed up delivery around leg, Dinesh allows it to spin and blocks it from the crease.
A bit of confusion but all safe. Loopy ball around off, Chandimal taps it towards covers. He is interested to get a run but is sent back.
Floats it gently around middle, Chandimal watches the ball well and blocks it off his front foot.
Outside off, Dimuth pushes it towards point.
Fuller ball around middle and leg, he clips it off his pads through mid-wicket for a brace.
A silly mid off and a silly mid on in place.
Drives this ball to mid off.

FOUR! Ahh! Glorious! You hardly associate the word with the cut shot but that's how it is! Length delivery outside off, Karunaratne stays deep in the crease and plays it through cover-point. The ball teases the fielders before making contact with the boundary cushions. Brings up 3000 runs for the southpaw in the longest format of the game.
A tad fuller around off, driven back to mid off.
Amir runs in and lands it on a length outside off, Karunaratne stays in the crease and punches it towards covers.
Finally! MOHAMMAD AMIR to bowl for the first time today. Will he end up delivering what is expected of him?
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This delivery around middle and off is defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Floats it around off, Chandimal defends it from within the crease.
Chandimal reads the spin and smothers it off his front foot.
Karunaratne lets the ball turn and come to him, and nudges it through backward square leg for a run.
Tossed up ball outside off, Karunaratne looks to fetch the sweep. Gets an inside edge onto his thigh as the ball rolls to the off side.
Bangs it short around middle, Dinesh gets low to duck under that and let that go.
Now Riaz runs in from over the wicket and serves a length delivery around middle and off. Chandimal stays in the crease and blocks it off the inside half of his bat.
On a length around off, Chandimal defends it from the crease.
This is too wide of off to make the batsman play.
Sprays this full outside off, the Lankan skipper is not bothered to play that.
Wahab runs in and bowls it with a slightly slingy action around off. Chandimal stays in the crease and plays it watchfully.
Another ball around off, defended off the front foot by Dimuth.
Shah lands it around middle and off, Karunaratne camps back and blocks it with a dead bat.
Similar delivery, pushed from the crease towards mid-wicket.
This is a flipper around off, Dimuth picks it and defends it by getting behind the line of the delivery.
A tad quicker outside off, the ball spins into DK. He goes back and is watchful in his defense.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Karunaratne gets a nice stride forward and defends it off the front foot with his bat and pad close to each other.
A leg slip and a short leg in place for Karunaratne. What's more, it's a 7-2 on-side heavy field!
This ball is bunted off the front foot onto the ground.

Wahab Riaz is always susceptible of landing in the danger area. This might be the reason why he is continuously seen coming from round the wicket today. Although it eliminates his landing problem, his effectiveness is reduced a bit.
Short delivery around leg, pulled through backward square leg for a run.
This ball in line of the stumps is played from within the crease.
On a length around middle and off, DK pushes it towards point.
Another effort ball from Wahab down the leg side. Karunaratne watches it go to the keeper without bothering to play that.
A slower delivery around leg, Dimuth plays it from the crease.
Riaz bangs it short again, but Karunaratne pulls it along the ground through backward square leg for a brace. In a bid to put in that extra effort, Wahab has overstepped and it is a no ball!
This floated up ball around off is played from the crease.
Gives it a bit more air around middle and off, Chandimal defends it off the front foot, back towards the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, Dinesh guides it past backward point for a brace.
This delivery is flicked towards mid-wicket.
Starts off with a loopy delivery in line of the stumps, which is met with the full face of Chandimal's bat.
YASIR SHAH to bowl now. Ahmed is resorting to spin before Amir's spell!

Snorter! But the absence of a silly point means that Karunaratne gets away with it! Riaz bangs it short around leg, the angle across makes it a tad difficult for the southpaw. Looks to fend, but takes his eyes off the ball and ends up getting it off the shoulder of the bat to the vacant area in the off side.
Riaz continues round the wicket even to Karunaratne. He bangs it short around leg, Dimuth ducks in response.
Back of a length delivery on the body, Chandimal stays back and clips it down to fine leg for one run.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Chandimal ducks and lets it go. Wasn't really too short to duck under, but the delivery was well away from the batsman so he got away with that.
Length ball around off, Chandimal stays in the crease and watches the ball onto the bat from the crease.
Wahab steams in and lands a length delivery outside off. Dinesh stays in the crease and chops it next to the pitch on the off side.
Yet another delivery outside off is left alone.
Serves a ball that is well outside off, the southpaw doesn't bother fiddling with that.
This is bowled outside off, Dimuth lets it be.
Excellent running yet again! Abbas serves a full delivery coming in to the batsman, Chandimal clips it in front of square on the leg side. They run three before the fielder retrieves the ball.

Very full outside off, Karunaratne doesn't need a second invitation to score runs the way he is playing. Drives it away from the body through covers and collects three as the ball slows down near the fence.
Runs in and bowls it full around off and middle, Dimuth drives it back to the bowler.
Very full ball outside off, Dinesh leaves it alone.
Length delivery around middle and leg, Chandimal looks to fend it away but is a bit early into the shot. Gets it off his thigh pads towards square leg.
Full outside off, nicely driven to mid off.
Comes round the wicket and sprays it outside off, Chandimal just lets it be.
First runs of the day for the centurion! Riaz slants a full delivery around off and middle, Karunaratne clips it wide of the mid on fielder to take off for a quick run and complete it.
Playing his first ball of the day, Karunaratne pushes that fullish ball around off, back towards the bowler.
The players are profusely sweating already. Shows how humid it is in Dubai!
This is bowled in line of the stumps, the Lankan skipper pushes it to mid-wicket.
Beaten! A hint of movement there, as signaled by Chandimal! Full ball outside off, Dinesh strides forward to play, but the ball moves away to beat the edge of the bat.
On a length outside off, Dinesh pushes it towards point.
Lands it on a fuller length outside off, Chandimal gets a bit squared up and ends up defending it towards backward point.
A tad fuller around off, Chandimal lunges forward and pushes it towards covers.
He begins with a delivery around off, Chandimal stays in the crease and blocks it.
Mohammad Abbas to bowl from the other end.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards covers with soft hands for a run. 7 runs off the first over of the day, the tourists are up and running!
Now Riaz comes round the wicket and lands it outside off, Chandimal points his bat skywards in response.
A tad fuller around off, Chandimal plays it through backward point for a brace.

FOUR! 13th Test fifty for the Sri Lankan skipper! And what a way to get the first runs of the day! Length delivery around middle and leg, Chandimal stays deep in the crease and just clips it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Another full delivery outside off, Dinesh covers the stumps and lets that through.
Starts off with a full delivery sprayed wide of the off stump. Chandimal has nothing to do with it first up and lets the keeper do the rest, by shouldering arms to that.

So we are all set for play! The home side has a short huddle just for some final discussions. The news is that Mohammad Amir is available and fit to bowl. Dimuth Karunaratne and Dinesh Chandimal stride out to resume their innings with the bat. Amir cannot bowl for 12 minutes as he was off yesterday and so Pakistan begin with Wahab Riaz! Two slips in place. Let's roll...

The way they are playing, who would have imagined that Sri Lanka were the underdogs at the start of this series. Dimuth Karunaratne is still unbeaten after scoring a century and would look to continue from where he left off last night. He is amidst an unbeaten century stand with Chandimal, who has looked poised to say the least. The hosts would be happy that the scoring rate has been fairly low and the game isn't out of their grasps yet. Stay tuned for what promises to be another absorbing day of Test cricket!

Hello everybody! Mohammad Amir walked out of the field without completing his over late in the final session - it is with this memory that I welcome you to our coverage of Day 2 of this pink ball Test between Pakistan and Sri Lanka. How is he now? Would he take part in the proceedings of the day's play? Is he fit enough to bowl menacing spells to make life difficult for the opposition batsmen? These are the questions that every cricket enthusiast will have in mind. The home side would want him and the other bowlers, too, to skittle out the opposition as quickly as they can.
DAY 2, SESSION ONE...

It already seems to be slipping away from Pakistan, although Sri Lanka have not run away with the game yet, owing to their slow scoring rate. The home team needs wickets and that too in heaps to stay relevant. It's them who are behind the 8-ball at this point as far as the series is concerned and will have to make the move. Sri Lanka on the other hand will be satisfied with their progress and will look to bat for as long as possible. Promises to be a riveting day tomorrow. Do join us at 1400 local (1000 GMT) for all the action. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Pakistan did manage to claw their way back after the tea break, picking two wickets in quick time but what followed next was an unbeaten century stand between Dimuth Karunaratne and skipper Dinesh Chandimal. It's been a nearly chanceless knock from the pair (Chandimal dropped on 1 by Abbas) and the opener, in particular, batted with a lot of composure. The Sri Lankan skipper has batted in his typical style, consuming too many balls but his concentration has been top notch to tire the opposition bowlers who anyways were flat on most occasions. Amir rushed off the field close to the end of day's play and his fitness will be closely monitored for tomorrow.

End of a satisfying day's play for Sri Lanka. They won an important toss on a batting-friendly track and their openers provided a decent start after weathering the early storm. Yasir Shah provided Pakistan with their first breakthrough but after that we witnessed a young man, on his debut, giving us a glimpse of some extraordinary batting, reminding many of the great Mahela Jayawardene. Yes, I'm talking about Sadeera Samarawickrama who was absolutely brilliant in his little knock which  was studded with delightful strokes.
Tossed up ball on of, Karunaratne gets it away from the inner half of the bat to square leg. Stumps on day 1!
Some tweaking in the field. More close-in fielders now.
Gets it from the middle of the bat, plays with the spin but towards square leg.
Turning down the leg side, Dimuth tries to flick but misses.
Walks down to the pitch of the delivery and blocks.
Spinning down the leg side, Dimuth lets it takes his pads on its way towards leg gully.
Sharp spin back into the batsman from outside off, Karunaratne tries defending but misses and is hit on the pads.
Too straight in line on this occasion. Chandimal eases it behind square leg and takes a couple of runs.
This is beautiful bowling by Abbas. He is getting the ball to nip around. Another one in the trajectory outside off, Chandimal pushes inside the line, flat-footed, and gets beaten.

Not out! It was an excellent delivery, angling in around off on a fuller length and nipping away a shade after pitching. Chandimal lunges to work it on the leg side but is squared up while doing so. It takes his pads and runs past the keeper and the slip fielders for a boundary. They appeal but the umpire stays unmoved. Sarfraz thinks for a while and then opts for the DRS. The replays roll in and it detects a tiny outside edge. The decision stays as it is, only change - it's been told to the umpire to give it as FOUR runs as umpire Kettleborough gave it leg byes initially. 250 up for Sri Lanka.
Shout for an lbw, not given. Sarfraz Ahmed thinks for some time before taking the referral.
FOUR! Sweetly timed! Full in length on middle, Chandimal leans forward and across before clipping it beautifully in front of square leg for a glorious boundary.
Another one in the region outside off, Dinesh allows it through.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Skidding away from the batsman, Dimuth pushes inside the line and misses.
Quicker ball on middle, Chandimal works it square of the wicket on the leg side for one.
Flighted and outside off, spinning away, Chandimal allows it through.
Mohammad Amir pulls out in his delivery stride. Not sure what happened. Maybe, hammy. Yasir Shah to finish the over.
Back of a length ball angling into the batsman, Chandimal shuffles across the stumps a bit and defends it back.
Wayward delivery. Short and way wide outside off, another comfortable leave for the Sri Lankan skipper.
Runs in from around the wicket and bowls a harmless length delivery outside off, Chandimal leaves it alone.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Straighter in line, worked on the leg side but straight to the fielder.
Beaten! Fine delivery. Full in length just around off, bringing the batsman forward. Karunaratne tries blocking it but it nips away to beat the outside edge.
Way wide outside off, an easy leave for Karunaratne.
Play and a miss! On a good length outside off, a little too close to cut but Dimuth still goes after it. Ends up swishing and missing.
Full in length outside off, Karunaratne drives it off his front foot to covers.
Dinesh Chandimal is still down. He looks to be in some serious pain out there. The physio attends him and after a few sprays and some treatment, he's alright to play.

NOT OUT! Pakistan lose a review! For the last ball of the over, Amir goes around the wicket for the last ball of the over, pitches it on off and it comes back into Chandimal who offers no stroke and is hit on the back leg somewhere near the knee. He is down in pain but Pakistan are desperately appealing. Umpire Nigel Llong stays unmoved. Sarfraz Ahmed after a chat with his bowler, opt for the review. Replays show the ball was not doing much and would have missed the stumps. Impact cannot be an issue here anyway as the batsman was not offering shot.
A loud shout for an LBW but umpire Nigel Llong stays put. It has hit Chandimal on the back leg, near the knee roll. After a thought, Sarfraz opts to review it...
Fuller and wider outside off, Chandimal shoulders his arms to it.
Comes back in from outside off, Chandimal defends it down.
Chandimal nearly falls! Amir offers width as he slants it outside off, Chandimal looks to drive and nearly takes the outside edge. That was close.
Slants it away on a length outside off, shouldered arms to.
Slightly short and served around off, blocked off the back foot gently.
A bit fuller outside off, driven on the up towards the cover fielder.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Another length delivery outside off, left alone.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
FOUR! Uppish but safe! Fuller and sprayed wider outside off, Karunaratne goes after it. Gets it off the outside edge which flies behind point for a boundary.
Abbas keeps it on a length and it nips back in to ping Karunaratne on the back leg. He appeals but replays show there was an inside edge.
Gets forward but mistimes his drive towards mid off.
Spears in a full ball, straightening a touch, Chandimal defends.
Stays back and works with the angle behind square on the leg side for a single.

How did that miss the off pole? Amir is down on his haunches! Sarfraz wears a surprise smile on his face. Amir angles one in around off, it straightens a touch and beats Karunaratne to nearly take his off pole apart.
On a length and outside off, punched off the back foot towards point.
Pakistan have finally taken the second new ball. Mohammad Amir to steam in first up. Straightaway two slips for him.
Starts off from over the wicket and angles one into the batsman, Dimuth is solid in his defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On a good length and outside off, Chandimal is early into his tuck shot and as a result he gets a leading edge towards the off side. Luckily, it falls in no man's land.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot towards the mid off fielder.
Angling in on middle, worked with the angle towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Chandimal goes back to cut but gets it off the bottom edge towards the off side.
Length delivery outside off, defended off the front foot.
Mohammad Abbas back on for another spell.
Karunaratne stays on the leg side, Shafiq fires it there. The batsman defends it past short leg.
Quicker one on leg, tucked on the bounce towards the short leg fielder.
Wide! Fires it down the leg side, Dimuth leaves it alone.
Short and outside off, Chandimal camps back and punches it through the line for a single.
Charges down the wicket and eases it down to long on for a comfortable single. Brings up the 100-run partnership as well. These two continue to make merry.
Once again bowls it around leg, Chandimal clips it through square leg for a single.
Flatter one down the leg side, Chandimal clips it towards the short fine leg fielder.
Dimuth gets to the pitch of the ball and turns it to mid-wicket.
Mohammad Amir is loosening up. Should be in next to have a crack with the new cherry...
Loopy delivery around off, Karunaratne strides forward and defends.
This delivery is turned round the corner by Dimuth.
Bowls it around middle and leg, Chandimal turns it through backward square leg for a run.
Lands it around leg, Dinesh lunges forward and blocks it showing the full bat face.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Second new ball is available now. Pakistan aren't too keen to take it.
Once again keeps it outside leg, padded away by the southpaw.
Keeps the line outside leg, Karunaratne just pads it away past short leg.
Full and around leg, bunted back to Shafiq.
Floats it up around middle and off, Dimuth lunges forward and defends it down.

Once again spills one down the leg side, the batsman lets it be. Ramiz Raja on air informs that, if he bowls one more down the leg side, he may face some issue. He adds, Shafiq was already given a warning for bowling the negative lines.
Flatter and down the leg side, Dimuth lets it be.
Gets behind the line and blocks it out into the ground.
Chandimal takes a good stride forward and stonewalls it.
Gets to the pitch of the ball and whips it past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Bowls it a bit short outside off, goes back and tucks it through backward square leg for a single.
Flattish around middle and leg, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
Dances down and drives it down to long on for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated delivery outside off, steps out again and drives it straight to the silly mid off fielder.
Karunaratne steps out, it's too full. All he could do is bunt it back to the bowler.
Flighted ball outside off, driven towards the cover fielder.
Gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it down to long on for a single.
On the pads, flicked it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Gives it a nice flight outside off, Dinesh Chandimal leans forward and pushes it towards the fielder at cover.
Darted on the pads, worked away towards square leg.
Loopy delivery outside off, pushed towards the mid off fielder.
Lunges forward and blocks it down watchfully.
Fires it full on the stumps, jammed out towards mid on.
Floated delivery outside off, Chandimal comes down a couple of steps and pushes it towards the cover fielder.
A tad shorter outside off, cut away to point.
Lands it full outside off, Dimuth drives it towards covers.
This ball is again played with a dead bat off the front foot.
This is bowled a bit more slower through the air, Karunaratne blocks it off the front foot onto the ground.
Fired on the pads, Dinesh works it off his pads for a run.
Shafiq tosses this up outside off, Chandimal pushes it back towards the bowler.
He serves a shortish ball outside off, Karunaratne goes back and cuts it in front of point for a brace.
Sohail lands it around off, Chandimal drives it through covers for one.
Floated delivery around middle, Dimuth drives it and collects a run to long on.
Bowled in line of the stumps, he works it round the corner.
Tossed up ball around middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for one run.
Haris lands it around middle and leg, Karunaratne clips it through backward square leg for a run.
Drinks are on the field!
Loopy ball around middle and off, helped through the same region but for a single this time.
Floats it up outside off, flicked wide of the mid-wicket fielder for a brace.
Flatter one outside off, punched towards mid on for a single.
Darts it on the stumps, worked away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Around middle and off, Dimuth lunges forward in defense.
Flatter one outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Asad Shafiq is back on!
Runs down to the pitch if the delivery and eases it down to long on for a single.
Keeps his bat close to the pad and blocks it down.
Tosses it up outside off, Karunaratne gets down and plays the reverse sweep. Mohammad Abbas from backward point gives it a chase and keeps them down to two.
Drops it short on off, punched through covers for a single.
Leans ahead and drives it towards the mid off fielder this time.
Tosses it up around off, pushed off the front foot towards cover.
Haris Sohail is asked to roll his arm over.
Outside off, turning way down leg, Dimuth moves inside the line to keep Ahmed busy behind the sticks.
Around off, coming back in, defended off the back foot.
It's the attempted wrong 'un which doesn't turn! Dimuth cracks it through covers and collects two before Ali mops it up.
Floated delivery outside off, blocked into the ground.
Tosses it outside off, it spins massively down leg. DK moves inside the line to let it be. A good take from Ahmed behind the stumps too.
Tossed up delivery outside off, defended by lunging forward.
Shortish and bowled in the channel outside off, tapped with soft hands.
Good length delivery on middle, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
Beaten! Slower one outside off, Karunaratne gets deceived by it. The ball sneaks under his bat, goes behind to Sarfraz who gets a bad bounce and fumbles.
Short of a length delivery outside off, cut away straight to the man at point.
Sprays it wide outside off, shouldered arms to it.
Wahab is bending his back here! Bangs in a short ball on middle, Karunaratne ducks to let that one over him to the keeper.
FOUR! Smacked! Drops it short and a bit wide outside off. The Lankan skipper takes the bait as he camps back and slashes it through backward point for a boundary to end the over.
Beautiful! Flighted delivery on off, Chandimal plays down the wrong line. The ball turns away and just beats the outside edge of his bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted delivery around off, blocked watchfully.
Bowls a quicker full ball on off, defended nicely by lunging forward again.
Floats it up around middle and off, defended into the ground.
After two full balls, Riaz bangs in a short ball on middle, Karunaratne is quick to take the evasive action. He ducks under it.
Once again bowls the slower one, well outside off. Left alone by the southpaw.
Slower delivery around off, whipped towards the fielder at mid on.
Angles one on the hips, tucked fine down the leg side for a single.
Tries to hit the deck hard, keeps it a bit wide outside off, crunched off the back foot but finds the fielder at point.
Riaz changes the angle, comes around the wicket and hurls a fuller ball on off. Chandimal lunges forward and keeps it out gently.
A bit fuller around the pads, nudged towards mid-wicket.
Bowls it outside off, turning way down the leg side. DK moves inside the line to let it be.

SIX! Goes with the turn and it's a biggie! Tossed up delivery outside off, turning in, Dimuth Karunaratne skips down the track and goes bang over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. That's some way to bring up the 200 for the Lankans.
Allows the ball to turn back in and defends it down.
Once again attempts a similar shot but this time the fielder is quick to stop the ball by diving to his right.
Floats it up outside off, Karunaratne gets into the position early and reverse sweeps it through point to collect a brace.
Good length delivery on middle and off, covers the line and offers a straight bat in defense.
Wahab Riaz was seen landing near the danger zone. The umpire, however, failed to spot that and Riaz gets lucky to get away with that one. Needs to be careful here.
Full and pacy ball on the stumps, Dimuth once again fails to jam it out cleanly. Gets an inside edge down to fine leg for a single.
Spears in a fuller ball at the base of middle stump, Karunaratne looks to dig it out but gets it off the inner half towards square leg.
Touch fuller and served outside off, blocked off the front foot and into the ground.
Back of a length delivery outside off, stays back and defends it down.
On a length and outside off, punched off the back foot towards the off side.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

That was a lovely ball! Quicker full ball, served on off, Chandimal is undone by the away turn and Ahmed behind the stumps fumbles to take it on the second attempt. There was some noise but nothing doing. The sound was of the bat hitting the pad.
Floats it up around middle and off, defended by leaning forward.
Chandimal comes forward to this tossed up ball but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Flatter through the air outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Tossed up delivery around middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.
Yasir Shah is back into the attack.
Good length delivery on middle and off, defended off the front foot.

FOUR! There it is, 7th Test ton for Dimuth Karunaratne! It's been a calm and composed knock from the southpaw and look at the joy on his face. Takes the helmet off and the arms go aloft. Chandimal runs towards him and gives him a tight hug. Coming to the ball, back of a length delivery outside off, Karunaratne opens the bat face and gets it behind point to the third man fence for a boundary. Well played, DK!

FOUR! Bang! Short ball from Amir, Karunaratne rocks back in a jiffy and pulls it off the meat of the bat through deep backward square leg to pick up a boundary. He has timed the pants off that one. Yasir Shah in the deep seemed to have lost it under the lights.
Fuller and curling back in on the pads, Chandimal clips it towards wide mid on and takes a single. Brings up the 50-run stand too.
Chandimal leans forward and pushes it towards the point fielder.
Sprays it away on a length outside off, Chandimal lifts his bat to let Sarfraz do some work.
Back of a length delivery on off, defended with a straight bat towards cover.
Gets a bit forward and pushes it towards cover.
Good stop, Yasir! Riaz is once again on the shorter side, cracked off the back foot towards point where Yasir dives full length to his left to stop some runs.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Dimuth gets on top of it and punches it off the back foot towards Azam at cover.
Back of a length outside off, stabbed off the back foot towards point this time.
Starts from over the wicket, tries to hit the deck hard, Karunaratne punches it towards Yasir Shah at cover-point. Wants the single but is sent back.

The two umpires converge during the break as there is some issue with the ball. My colleague jokes saying they have come together due to bad light! Anyway, the ball seems to have lost its shape and another one is handed over. Wahab Riaz to have a go with it first up. Can the change in ball work wonders for Pakistan?
Once again slants it away from the Lankan skipper, Chandimal has got nothing to do with that one.
Now changes the pace! An off cutter, served full on off, Dinesh prods forward in defense.
Covers the sticks and defends it showing the full face of the bat back to the bowler.
Angles it away this time, around off, Chandimal lunges forward to it and defends it down gently.
On a length around middle and off, blocked by leaning forward.
Good length delivery on middle, coming back in, Chandimal is undone by the inward movement there as he somehow manages to tuck it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller and trying to bring the back back into the southpaw. Dimuth looks to drive but gets an inside edge as the ball rolls towards mid on.
On a back of a length outside off, Chandimal gets back and punches it towards covers for a single.
Much better from the bowler! Length ball outside off, Dinesh Chandimal is right behind the line to defend it down.
Drifts it again around the pads, flicked in front of square leg by Chandimal. Adds two more to his tally.
Angles it in on middle, Chandimal clips it off his hips behind square on the leg side. Amir from fine leg mops it up. They take two. Abbas shakes his head as he walks back near the run-up mark.
Abbas tries to attack the stumps, it's fuller on the pads, pushed off the front foot towards mid on.

FOUR! Shot! Amir goes short, but it sits up at a good height for Karunaratne! He swivels just a touch and pulls it with full control through backward square leg. There were two men in the deep but the ball pierces right between them to cross the fence. Into the 90s goes Dimuth.
Fuller and on middle and leg, lucky to get away with that one. Flicked straight to mid-wicket.
Marginally ahead of a length on off, Karunaratne leans forward and drives it towards the cover-point fielder.
Good lines from Amir! Sprays it a bit wider on off, Dimuth isn't keen to go after it.
Once again bowls it around middle, on a length, kept out solidly.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Karunaratne stays behind to defend it with a straight bat.
Mohammad Amir to bowl from the other end!
Pretty harmless outside off, Chandimal shoulders his arms.
Slightly fuller on off, driven on the up but straight to mid off.
Goes too straight on this occasion, Chandimal flicks it through backward square leg and hares back for a couple.
Angles it in on middle and off, a solid back foot defense from Dinesh.
On a good length and pitched on off, zipping a touch off the surface, left alone with ease.
Abbas comes in from over the wicket and angles it on from around off, Chandimal is right behind the line to defend it down.

The players and the umpires make their way out to the center one last time today. The ball will start to do more under the lights and given that Pakistan have three pacers, expect them to do the talking with the ball. Dimuth Karunaratne and Dinesh Chandimal will resume their innings with the bat. Mohammad Abbas to kickoff proceedings.
DAY 1, SESSION THREE...

Amir had a sensational spell where he got rid of Samarawickrama with a one-man effort. Shah also bowled a long spell and he is beginning to get more assistance from the track as some deliveries are turning sharply. The hosts will be vary of the threat that this pair possesses and would look to break this stand as quickly as they can after the break. Do join us for the post-supper session in a while.

31 overs, 78 runs, 2 wickets - these are the relevant figures for the session. While Pakistan were clinical to begin with, the visiting skipper Chandimal and the opener Karunaratne have ensured that there are no more slip-ups. The southpaw is looking good to get to another big score. The former, after being dropped on 1, would look to make it count, although it was a very hard chance.
Shafiq lands it around middle, Karunaratne pushes it towards mid-wicket. That's DINNER, DAY 1!
Loopy ball in line of the stumps, Chandimal knocks it down to long on for a run. Strangely, he shouted 'no' before going through with the run.
Shafiq fires this on the pads at 96 kph, Dimuth works it away through square leg for a run.
Karunaratne gets behind the line of the ball and blocks that.
This delivery outside off is pushed towards covers.
What a ball! Shafiq tosses it up outside off, Karunaratne lunges forward to block. But the ball closely passes the edge of the bat.
Tossed up ball in line of the stumps, Dinesh lunges forward and blocks.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
This leg spinning ball outside off is left alone by Chandimal.
Served on the pads, turned away towards deep mid-wicket for one run.
Yasir floats it around middle, Karunaratne gets down and sweeps it over square leg. Riaz runs to his left, puts in the dive and saves a couple of runs for his side.
Tossed up ball around off is defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Shafiq comes round the wicket and lands it around leg, Chandimal turns it to mid-wicket.
Around middle and leg, this is pushed to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball outside off, Chandimal looks to paddle but misses and gets hit on the front pad. The players put in an appeal but the umpire stays unmoved. The impact could have been outside off.
Tossed up ball around off and middle, turned away off his pads.
This ball is flicked away to the square leg fielder.
A tad shortish outside off, slapped through covers for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Another delivery outside off, left alone.
This ball is defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Shah comes round the wicket and lands it around leg, Chandimal offers no stroke and pads it away. The players appeal but to no avail.
This is driven through mid on for a run.
Floats it around off, Karunaratne goes back and turns it behind square in the leg side.
This ball is flicked round the corner.
This ball is driven through mid off.
Karunaratne collects a run by pushing it towards covers.
Karunaratne defends this ball off the back foot.
This ball is defended off the front foot by Karunaratne.
Begins with a loopy ball outside off, Karunaratne stays back and cuts it towards backward point.
Off spinner Asad Shafiq is brought in to bowl now.
This is driven towards covers.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
This ball is defended by getting right behind the line of the ball.
Floated outside off, Chandimal drives it through covers, where Sohail dives to prevent runs.
Tossed up ball in line of the stumps, Chandimal gets down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a brace.
Slow loopy ball around off, spinning away from the batter. Dinesh covers the stumps and shoulders arms.
A tad fuller around off, driven to the fielder at mid off.
This is bowled in line of the stumps, Dimuth plays that from within the crease.
Length around off, driven to mid off.

Abbas hurls a length ball outside off, Chandimal pushes it to the left of mid off and rushes for a quick run. Ali the fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Could have been close had he hit, shows the replay.
This length delivery is punched to covers.
Abbas runs in and bowls a gentle fuller ball at around 126 kph. The Lankan skipper drives it to the fielder at mid off.
This delivery is worked round the corner.
Loopy ball around middle, turned towards mid-wicket.
This ball is flicked to mid-wicket.
It was an attempted wrong 'un around off, Karunaratne goes back and blocks that. Extra bounce on that occasion and the batsman did well to ride the bounce there.
Only one, shouts Ahmed as Chandimal sweeps the ball towards fine leg. The fielder does keep it down to one.
Serves a loopy ball around middle and leg, turning away. Chandimal offers the full face of the bat as he blocks that.
Fuller ball outside off, swings away as it passes the batsman. Karunaratne doesn't bother playing at that. Back-to-back maidens for Abbas!
On a length well outside off, Dimuth takes a stride forward and points his bat skywards as he lets that go.
Another length delivery bowled by Abbas outside off, DK covers his stumps and watches the ball fly to the keeper.
Spears this full outside off, Karunaratne covers his stumps and lets that go.
Length delivery on the pads, clipped to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Full ball outside off, driven to mid off.
Tossed up ball around off is blocked showing the full face of the bat.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Loopy ball bowled from over the wicket, Chandimal defends it off his front foot.
This delivery is worked around the corner for one run.
