Karunaratne reverse sweeps yet again! Loopy ball outside off, he gets a top edge playing that shot. The ball flies over backward point. The batsmen get a couple. Wonder why he has to resort to this shot, as without that he is doing well enough.
Loopy ball delivered wide off the crease, Dimuth takes a couple of steps down and bunts it.
This is again landed outside off, Chandimal covers his stumps and lets that go. A non-testing maiden over from Abbas!
A tad fuller around off, pushed towards covers from the crease.
Abbas hurls a length delivery outside off, Dinesh stays deep in the crease and slaps it to the fielder at cover-point.
This is bowled around off, Dinesh flicks it towards mid-wicket.
He lands it on a length outside off, Chandimal doesn't bother playing that.
On a length around off, Chandimal defends it from within the crease.
Loopy ball around off, Dimuth charges down the track and blocks that.
Floated ball around off, blocked off the front foot.
This ball is flicked off his pads towards square leg.
Tossed up ball around off, Dimuth defends with his bat and pad close together. Ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads that lands well short of the diving short leg fielder.
This is flatter and quicker around off and middle, turning down the leg side, Dimuth goes back and looks to turn it away but misses.
Goes wide of the crease from round the wicket and lands it outside off. Karunaratne defends it off the front foot.
Fuller delivery tailing into the batsman, Chandimal pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery around middle and leg, Karunaratne stays deep and works it with soft hands in front of square on the leg side. He crosses over for a run.
On a length outside off, the southpaw points his bat skywards as he lets that one go to the keeper.
Similar delivery outside off, Karunaratne shoulders arms to let that go.
Abbas now comes over the wicket and spears it on a length outside off. Karunaratne covers his stumps and watches the ball go to the keeper.
Abbas lands it outside off, driven to mid off.
This ball is pushed towards covers.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Floated around off, pushed back towards the bowler.
Lovely comeback from Yasir! Loopy delivery outside off, Chandimal strides forward to defend but the ball spins away to beat the edge of the bat.

FOUR! Chandimal's plan is to attack the spinner, it seems! Yasir tosses it up in line of the stumps, Dinesh gets down and slogs it yet again. This time the ball flies over the square leg fielder and rolls away to the fence.
Loopy ball around off, blocked off the front foot.
Length ball, defended off the back foot by Dimuth.
This ball is flicked round the corner.
FOUR! That isn't the ideal line to bowl to anyone, leave alone a set batsman! Abbas strays on the pads, Karunaratne is just too happy to flick it away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
This delivery is pushed towards covers.
Bowled in line of the off stumps, Karunaratne defends it from the crease.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Mohammad Abbas is back into the attack. He is getting small spells here.
Chandimal defends this ball off the back foot.
This is bowled outside off, left alone.

FOUR! What happened there! Shah loops it up in line of the stumps, Chandimal gets down on one knee and slogs it in front of square on the leg side. The ball passes the fielder at short leg, who ducks and races away to the fence. On replays, it is seen that technically, it's a DROPPED CHANCE as Abbas at square leg got some fingertips onto that. 150 up for Sri Lanka!
This ball is driven to mid off.
Similar delivery, this time worked to the right of short leg.
Tossed up ball on the pads, turned towards square leg from the left of short leg.

Drinks have been taken! Pakistan would be pretty happy with this hour's proceedings as they have managed to pick up two wickets. What would be more encouraging for them is the fact that Amir is looking good with the ball and so is Shah. The set Karunaratne was also troubled on a couple of occasions. The tourists would look to continue scoring runs, and even if not runs, they would guard well against losing further wickets.

FOUR! As straight as it gets! Amir spears it full on off, Karunaratne gets his front foot forward and drives it down the ground for a boundary. Neither the bowler nor the mid off fielder could do anything to stop that!
This delivery around off is pushed back towards the bowler.
On a length around off, Karunaratne shows the full face of the bat and defends that.
The lights are starting to take effect at the Dubai International Stadium!
Fuller delivery outside off, Karunaratne drives it towards covers.
This ball is knocked towards mid-wicket.
Amir hurls it around off, Dimuth pushes it towards mid off.
Tossed up ball outside off, Chandimal allows it to turn and go to the keeper as he points his bat skywards.
Serves it around off, Dinesh blocks it getting a stride forward.
This is bowled outside off, he doesn't bother playing that.
Loopy delivery around off and middle, Dimuth turns it past short leg for a run. For some reason, Ahmed is seen yelling at the fielder from behind the stumps.
Oh Karunaratne, what's that! Shah loops it up around off and the ball spins in. Dimuth for some reason looks to play the reverse sweep but misses the ball completely. It's so unlike DK!
Shah continues round the wicket and serves it full around off. Karunaratne defends it off the front foot towards mid-wicket.
Similar delivery outside off, Dinesh covers his stumps and doesn't bother playing that.
Spears it on a length outside off, Chandimal shoulders arms to let that go to the keeper.
A tad fuller around off, DC defends it off the front foot.
On a length outside off, the skipper pushes it towards the cover region.
Length delivery around off, Dinesh defends it from within the crease.
Beautifully played! Amir hurls it full around off and middle, Karunaratne gets forward and clips it past mid on. Before the fielder retrieves the ball, the batsmen pick up three runs.
Shah serves it around off, after coming round the wicket. Karunaratne goes back and works it away through square leg for a run.
Chandimal collects a run to get off the mark, after flicking this off his pads.
Loopy ball, turned round the corner off his pads.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Served in line of the stumps, defended from the crease.
Shah floats it up gently in line of the stumps, Chandimal lunges forward and blocks that.
Another delivery around off that is defended off the front foot.
Outside off, pushed towards covers.
This ball is blocked from within the crease.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the backfoot.
Look what the quick wickets have done to the set batsman! Amir bowls an off-cutter outside off, Karunaratne gets a thick outside edge that lands just short of the slip fielder.
Length delivery outside off, Dimuth looks to cut and ends up chopping it onto the ground.
Floated in line of the stumps, Dinesh gets a stride forward and bunts it.
Chandimal gets behind the line of the ball and keeps it out.
Another delivery around off is blocked off the front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
This is bowled around off, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Skipper DINESH CHANDIMAL strides out to bat next. Two quick wickets mean that now he will have to put his head down and bail the side out of trouble.

OUT! No, Mendis! You shouldn't have gone for it so early! Now Yasir Shah gets a wicket! The change of ends works for him. He tosses it up around middle and off, Mendis cannot resist the loop. Looks to go over mid on for a biggie and fails to watch the ball till the end. Ends up getting a thick outside edge that flies to the right of Shafiq at slip, who takes it smartly. It was a poor shot to say the least, as he could have taken the leaf from the innings that the youngster, Samarawickrama, earlier played. Pakistan sniff a chance here and the skipper's two inspired changes have got them two quick wickets, both off the first ball of the respective overs!
YASIR SHAH gets a change of ends.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

FOUR! Unlucky Amir, as it could have easily crashed onto the stumps! He serves it on a length around off, Karunaratne pushes at that with hard hands. Gets an inside edge and the ball passes close to the off stump and races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Pitched up a bit further around off, Mendis pushes it towards covers for a run. He gets off the mark with that.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Lands it around off, Mendis blocks it showing the full face of the bat.
KUSAL MENDIS walks in at the fall of the second wicket. The youngster would love to get among the runs and cash in on the conditions here.

OUT! Mohammad Amir, you beauty! What a brilliant catch to dismiss the newcomer and end the flourishing stand. He bowls it at a back of a length around middle, Samarawickrama looks to whip it away to the on side. But the ball gets big on him and he gets it off the top half of his bat. The ball flies to the left of the bowler, who shows good athleticism to rush there and catch that with a dive. Top, top effort by the pacer. The debutant looked in good flow but now the knock has come to an end. Amir gets his first wicket in the series and what a way that is!
MOHAMMAD AMIR is back on for another spell. Will he be able to break this stand? He has a silly mid off in place.
On a length around off, blocked off the back foot.
This ball us flicked off his pads towards square leg.
Wahab lands it around off, Dimuth defends showing the full face of the bat.
Length ball around off, defended off the front foot.
Short delivery around middle and leg, nicely pulled away through mid-wicket for a run. What's more, it is a no ball as Riaz has overstepped!
Sarfraz Ahmed is seen having a conference with Riaz and Amir. He might be getting concerned at the inability of his bowlers to restrict the run flow.
This delivery around off is driven to mid off.

FOUR! Shot! If you ask me, he isn't a newcomer and has been batting since ages at this level and on this ground! Riaz hurls it outside off, Samarawickrama strides forward and drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary.
Shah comes round the wicket and lands it around off, Dimuth goes back and flicks it towards square leg.
A tad shorter around off, punched through covers for a run.
Fired shorter around middle, pulled towards square leg.
Floated ball in line of the stumps, bunted off the front foot onto the ground.

SIX! High and handsome! Tossed up delivery around off, Samarawickrama charges down the track and goes over mid off. The ball goes high and over the ropes for a maximum. Is he playing a Test match or what! Such a confident shot against one of the better spinners going around.
Loopy ball around off, defended off the front foot onto the ground.
Another delivery is kept out from within the crease. A maiden from Riaz!
Karunaratne blocks this ball from within the crease.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This delivery around off is defended from within the crease.
This ball is defended off the back foot towards point.
Length delivery around off, pushed towards backward point.
This is landed around middle and leg, the batsman goes back and turns it towards mid on.

Ooooh! Deceived in flight! Yasir Shah floats it gently outside off, Samarawickrama looks to go downtown but had to abort the shot as he was just flummoxed by the bowler. Thankfully, he didn't get an edge there.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Tossed up ball outside off, cut towards point.
In response, Yasir bowls it quicker around off. Sadeera defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Goodness, glorious, gracious! Shah tosses this one generously around off, Samarawickrama charges down the track and plays it inside out over covers for a boundary. Beautifully played.
Another delivery around off is blocked off the front foot.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Bowled around off, defended off the front foot by Dimuth.
This is defended off the back foot.

Confusion, but all's well that ends well! It is a yorker around middle and leg, Karunaratne digs it to the leg side! He wants a run and Samarawickrama is quick to respond, but the senior partner sends him back. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Sadeera had made it in though.
Lands it on a length around off, Dimuth defends it from the crease.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the backfoot.
This ball is worked through square leg for a run.
This is a tad short around off, Dimuth goes back to pull but mistimes it next to short leg.

FOUR! Sri Lanka are dealing in boundaries here! Shah loops it up around off, Karunaratne takes it on the full and bashes it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Brings up the 50-run stand between these two off just 46 deliveries! They have just not let the fall of wicket affect their momentum.
This loopy delivery around off is defended off the front foot.
Shah comes round the wicket and serves it around off, Karunaratne goes back and blocks that.

FOUR! Ahh! Shows that the youngster is watching the ball and picking the length early and perfectly! Riaz gives him a short ball around middle and leg, Samarawickrama stays deep in the crease, watches the ball till the last moment and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Another ball outside off, this time driven towards covers.
Fuller ball around off, driven to mid off.
This delivery is played defensively off the front foot.
Length ball around off, the opener stays deep in the crease and pushes it towards point for a run. It is a no ball as Riaz has overstepped there.
Replays show that Wahab Riaz is close to the danger area in the pitch with his followthrough. Although he hasn't been warned officially yet, he'd do well to improve before the warning comes.
This ball outside off is knocked towards point.
Riaz starts with a fuller ball around off, Karunaratne pushes it back towards the bowler.
Wahab Riaz will bowl from the other end.
Shah floats it around off, the batter bunts it off his front foot onto the ground.

FOUR! What a shot that! Samarawickrama looks as if he belongs to the league already! Shah tosses this full outside off, Sadeera stays put and times his cover drive perfectly. The ball beats the diving fielder there and races away to the fence.
Shah serves it a tad shorter around middle, pulled away through square leg for a single by Dimuth.
Quicker on the pads, Karunaratne gets back and works it past leg slip for a brace.
Shah floats it around off and middle, Dimuth goes back and defends it from the crease.
Begins with a full loopy delivery outside off, Karunaratne drives it to mid off.

DAY 1, SESSION TWO... The men who matter make their way out to the middle. Dimuth Karunaratne will resume his innings with the bat with newcomer Sadeera Samarawickrama at the other end. Yasir Shah will continue his spell.

Pakistan began well with the new moving pink ball as Amir looked very threatening. Sadly for the hosts, that spell couldn't translate into a wicket for them. There would be a lot of introspection in their camp during the break. They would want to have some magic beverage in order for them to pick up some quick wickets. Join us in a while after the break.

Sri Lanka would be very happy with how their first day-night Test has panned out for them as yet! Their openers did a very good job of first being watchful and seeing off the threat of the new ball and then cashing in on the loose balls and accumulating runs. Yasir Shah got rid of Silva to end the opening stand, but the man playing his first game, Samarawickrama, has looked assured so far.
Beautifully played! Fuller delivery around off, the debutant drives it through covers for a brace. THAT'S TEA, DAY 1!
This ball is defended by getting behind the line of the ball.
Another ball outside off, left alone by Sadeera.
FOUR! Now Samarawickrama collects a streaky boundary! Amir bowls it outside off, the batsman gets a thick edge past backward point. The ball speeds away to the fence.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Length ball outside off, Sadeera shoulders arms and lets that one go.
This is flicked towards square leg.
Floated delivery around middle and leg, pushed towards mid on.

FOUR! 14th Test fifty for Dimuth Karunaratne! Well played, young man! Yasir Shah tosses this one around middle, the southpaw charges down, gets to the pitch of the ball and flicks it through mid-wicket. The ball eludes all the close-in fielders and rushes away to the fence. The opener has been really going through a good patch of late, and he needs to convert this into a big one.
Flatter around off, blocked off the back foot.
Played towards mid-wicket.
Now these are free runs. Shah bowls a shortish ball around off, Sadeera stays back and cuts it through backward point. The batsmen get three runs.
Amir bangs this short outside off, the southpaw ducks and lets it go. An expensive over by Amir as 12 came off that.
This is well outside off, left alone by Dimuth.

FOUR! And another one, the third of the over! Amir hurls a full ball around leg, Karunaratne gets some bat onto that as he looks to flick it. The ball speeds away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
FOUR! This is gloriously well played! Bowled in line of the stumps, Karunaratne flicks it a tad aerially through mid-wicket for another boundary. Back-to-back fours here!

FOUR! Karunaratne gets a streaky boundary! Amir hurls it full outside off, Dimuth looks to drive at that but ends up getting a thick edge that raced away to the fence through the gap between the slip cordon and the gully.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is back on!
Beaten all ends up! That was a straighter ball just around off, he looked to defend off the front foot but missed the ball completely. The ball wasn't too far away from the stumps!
Edged but safe! Shah bowls it flatter around off, Samarawickrama goes back and plays that with a half mind. Gets a thick edge past the slip fielder for a brace.
Karunaratne collects a run after punching it towards covers.
Flatter in line of the stumps, Dimuth goes back and shows the full face of the bat in defending that.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, flicked away towards mid-wicket.
This tossed up ball is turned away round the corner.
Short delivery around middle, pulled away through square leg for a run.
This ball is flicked away towards mid-wicket for one run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
First runs for Samarawickrama in Tests! Abbas bowls it around middle and leg, he flicks it towards fine leg for a brace.
Two slips in place for the debutant!
On a length on the pads, Karunaratne flicks it away through square leg for a single.
This delivery outside off is punched towards covers.
Floated ball around off, Samarawickrama drives it towards mid off.
The debutant SADEERA SAMARAWICKRAMA walks out to bat! He is the 143rd player to represent Sri Lanka in Tests.

OUT! Silva has to depart! On some days, good deliveries fail to get you a wicket, while on others, even the most unlikeliest ones earn you one! This is a half-tracker around off, spinning away a bit, Silva goes deep and looks to pull it away. Ends up getting an under edge which is gleefully accepted by the keeper Sarfraz Ahmed. The batsman seemed a tad too early into the shot and that brought about his downfall. The fielding effort off the previous ball also is a contributory to this wicket. End of a good opening stand for Lanka!
Shah lands it a tad shorter outside off, Kaushal goes deep in the crease and cuts it in front of point. The fielder at backward point, Sami Aslam gets there, puts in the dive and prevents a run.
Similar sequence of actions on this delivery.
Tossed up leg break around off, Silva allows the ball to come to the bat and defends it off the front foot.
Shah bowls a flatter one around middle and leg, Karunaratne gets low and paddles it towards short fine leg for a single.
The fast bowler bangs in a bouncer around off to end the over. Silva responds by ducking under it.
Length delivery around off, angling into the batsman, Silva taps it in front of him and wants a run. Changes his mind seeing the bowler rush to the ball.
This ball is pushed to covers by the opener.
Mohammad lands it a tad fuller around middle and leg, Karunaratne works it through square leg for a single.
Bowled outside off, DK punches it straight to the point fielder.
Abbas continues round the wicket and lands it on a fuller length around off. Dimuth pushes it defensively back towards the bowler.
This loopy ball is clipped towards mid-wicket by Silva.
Flatter in line of the stumps, Kaushal gets behind the line of the ball and blocks that.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! Scintillating shot from Silva! Shah tosses it up around middle and leg, Kaushal charges down the track quickly and hits it over the bowler's head for a boundary. Very good looking shot that, as he picked up the length and line pretty early.
This delivery is blocked off the front foot onto the ground.
Flatter ball around off, Silva stays deep in the crease and punches it towards point. The fielder puts in a dive and concedes no run.
Landed on the pads, the opener flicks it towards square leg.
Mohammad serves it full around middle and leg, Dimuth pushes it off the front foot towards mid on.
On a length around off, DK punches it off the back foot towards bowler.
This is a tad fuller around off and middle, Karunaratne defends it with an angled bat towards mid-wicket.
Another delivery well outside off is left alone by Dimuth.
Abbas steams in from round the wicket and hurls it full outside off, Karunaratne points his bat skywards in response.
This ball is played towards covers off the front foot. He wanted a run but is denied by his partner.

FOUR! That ball had to be punished and it is! Shah bowls a half-tracker around middle, giving Silva ample time to collect runs. He goes deep in the crease and pulls it in front of square on the leg side for a boundary. The head of the short leg fielder wasn't too far from the line of the ball!
This delivery is flicked through mid-wicket for a run.

50 up for Sri Lanka! Shah flights this outside off, Silva gets to the pitch of the delivery and drives it through covers. Before the fielder retrieves that, the batsmen run three. These two have done really well here and now it's time to reap rewards of the hard work.
Yasir floats it around off, Silva defends it off the front foot towards point.
Tossed up delivery around off, Silva paddles it towards fine leg for a brace.
Bouncer in line of the stumps, Dimuth ducks under that as he lets that go.
Length delivery around middle, clipped away wristily through mid-wicket for a brace.
On a length outside off, Silva taps it towards covers and sets off for a run. Masood gets there and hurls a throw at the striker's end but misses. Karunaratne had made it in though.
Hurls it down the leg side, Silva looks to flick but misses.
This is bowled outside off, Karunaratne drives it to the right of mid off. Azhar Ali gets there, puts in the dive and restricts the batsmen to just one. He saved a certain boundary there.
Fuller ball around off, driven back down the ground.
Mohammad Abbas is back on for another spell here.
Beaten! Loopy ball just outside off, Silva looks to defend it off the front foot. But he gets beaten as the ball spins away to the keeper. Ahmed puts in a withdrawn stifled appeal!

Miscommunication, but all safe! Shah floats it around middle and leg, Silva turns it in front of square on the leg side and sets off for a run. But Karunaratne sends him back. Kaushal does well to get in there, in spite of there being a direct hit at the striker's end.
Flatter delivery on the pads, flicked past short leg for a run.
Silva clips it through mid-wicket and collects a run.
Shah tosses this one, Silva charges down and takes it on the full but finds the square leg fielder. Doesn't get any run.
Tossed up ball around middle and leg, Karunaratne charges down and clips it towards deep mid-wicket for one run.
On a length around off, defended off the back foot by Kaushal.
Comes round the wicket and bowls it short down the leg side. Silva ducks under that. Riaz didn't land too well as his back leg just twisted a bit.
Length delivery on the pads, clipped towards fine leg for a single.
Wahab Riaz looks to be in some pain. After delivering the previous ball, as he was walking back, he clutched his knee and crouched in pain. But he seems good to continue.
Length ball outside off, Karunaratne punches it towards point.
Lands it fuller around middle and leg, pushed towards mid on.
Wahab runs in and hurls it on a length around off at 140 kph. Dimuth defends it from within the crease.
This ball is defended by getting right behind the line of the ball.
Yasir floats it around off, Silva hangs back in the crease and looks to defend. Gets it off the inside half of his bat.
Tossed up delivery around middle, turned away to mid-wicket.
Loopy delivery around leg, pushed towards short leg.
Now he bowls a full toss around leg but is lucky to get away with it. Silva clips it to mid-wicket.
Shah tosses this in line of the stumps, Karunaratne goes back and works it in front of square on the leg side for a run.

Drinks are on the field now! Sri Lanka have done well to negotiate the new ball in their first-ever day-night Test. What has been impressive here is that Karunaratne has done really well to stay in there after surviving Amir's probing initial burst. Pakistan would love this break to get them a breakthrough!
Another aimless bouncer at 137 kmph down the leg side. Silva ducks under that and lets it go.
Now Wahab bowls a bouncer in line of the stumps, the short Silva ducks under that and lets it go.
Very full ball outside off, Silva digs it out towards cover-point. Good strategy by Riaz to follow-up a short ball with a full one, but he needs to be better with his lines.
This is on a good length around off, Silva stays in the crease and defends it showing the full face of the bat.
Wahab lands it on a back of a length around middle and leg, Silva pushes it towards mid on.
Riaz hurls it full outside off, Silva shoulders arms to let that go.
Flatter delivery in line of the stumps, blocked from the crease.
Floated around middle, turned towards mid on by Dimuth.
Full loopy ball around leg, Silva pushes it towards mid-wicket for one run.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, turned towards mid-wicket for a run.
Lands it in line of the stumps, Dimuth goes back and defends from the crease.
Tossed up ball around off, Karunaratne charges down and drives it back towards the bowler. The ball rolled away towards mid off past the diving Yasir Shah.
Wonderfully bowled! Riaz spears this fuller outside off, Silva looks to block it off the front foot but the ball moves just a bit to beat the outside edge of the bat.
Back of a length delivery around middle and off, Silva pushes it towards point from within the crease.
On a length outside off, Silva covers the stumps and shoulders arms to that.
Hurled on a length outside off, Kaushal punches it through the gap between covers and point. Gets a couple before the fielder retrieves the ball.
Wahab bangs in a bouncer around middle, Silva crouches down low and lets that go.
Length ball outside off, Silva looks to block it but gets it off the inside half to the right of the pitch.
Shortish ball around middle and leg, pulled towards square leg. Yasir Shah begins with a maiden!
Floated delivery around off, driven towards mid off.
Flighted ball around off, Dimuth pushes it back towards the bowler.
Karunaratne blocks it off his front foot showing the full face of the bat.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Dimuth flicks it towards mid on.
Shah begins with a tossed up ball around off, Karunaratne strides forward and defends it off the front foot.
Spin time! Leg break bowler YASIR SHAH is introduced into the attack. Shows how desperate Ahmed is for a breakthrough.
Bowled well outside off, Silva points his bat skywards as he lets that go.
Length delivery around middle and leg, Silva taps it towards square leg. He wants a run but is rightly sent back by his partner.
Full delivery but very wide of off. Silva just lets it be and lets the keeper collect the ball.
Riaz hurls it on a length outside off, the batsman covers his stumps and watches the ball go to the keeper.
This is bowled outside off, Kaushal shoulders arms in response.
Wahab runs in and spears it full outside off, Silva watches the ball and lets it go through to the keeper.
Fuller ball outside off, driven towards covers over the leaping fielder there. The batsmen run one.
Back of a length delivery around off, Kaushal defends it from the crease onto the ground.
Silva defends this length ball from the crease. He played it off the inside of his bat.
Fuller delivery outside off, Silva doesn't bother playing at that.
Amir bangs in a bouncer around leg, Kaushal ducks under that and lets the keeper do the rest.
Good length ball around off, Silva blocks it off the front foot.
Fuller delivery around off, Karunaratne drives it uppishly down the ground. It fell just short of the diving Riaz and rolls down the ground for a brace. Wahab starts off with a 7-run over!
Riaz's perennial problem continues! He oversteps, just! Landed around off, Dimuth defends it from the crease.
FOUR! In the air but safe! Riaz angles it full on the pads, Karunaratne clips it uppishly over mid-wicket. The ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Another delivery around off, defended from the crease by Dimuth.
As compared to Abu Dhabi, the ball is coming onto the bat much better here in Dubai. So ideally, we should see more runs flow here than a block, block game.
This delivery around off is punched towards covers.
Length delivery outside off, Karunaratne mistimes his cut off the back foot. Ends up chopping it next to the pitch.
Riaz starts off with a length ball well outside off, Dimuth lets it be.
Quick change! WAHAB RIAZ is brought into the attack. He's taken a four-wicket haul with the pink ball earlier.
Fuller delivery outside off, Kaushal drives it to the cover-point fielder.
Amir comes round the wicket and lands it full outside off, Silva covers his stumps and lets that go to the keeper.
Just two slips now. The third slip is moved towards covers.
Another delivery outside off, shouldered arms to, by Silva.
Length delivery outside off moving away from the batsman. Silva stays in the crease and lets it go.
This ball is played defensively off the front foot.
Amir hurls it full on the pads, Karunaratne misses the flick, but the ball goes off his pads towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Length delivery on the pads, flicked away to fine leg for one run.
Abbas comes round the wicket and hurls it fuller around off. Karunaratne drives it back to the bowler.
Lands it on a length outside off, Karunaratne points his bat skywards as he lets that one go.
Good looking shot, but a dot ball! It is a full delivery around off, Dimuth drives it off the front foot to the cover fielder.
Abbas bowls it a tad fuller around middle and leg, Silva pushes it to the right of mid on for one run.
Abbas runs in and lands it around off, Kaushal shows the full face of the bat in defending that.

FOUR! The second of the over! After all the initial probing balls, Amir serves it full around middle and leg. Karunaratne gleefully clips it through mid-wicket for another boundary. 9 runs off that over!
This is landed outside off, Dimuth leaves it alone.
Amir responds to the previous delivery with a bouncer! It was outside off, Karunaratne sways away from the line and lets that go.
FOUR! The first of the match! Amir serves a half volley around middle and leg, Karunaratne does the needful by flicking it off his pads through square leg for a boundary.
Fuller delivery around middle and off, pushed back towards the bowler off the front foot.
Amir runs in and hurls it on a length around middle and off. Silva gets an inside edge past short leg for a run, as he looks to block that.
Another delivery on the pads, Karunaratne clips it off his pads through square leg. The batsmen get a couple there.
Bowled on a length around leg, Dimuth defends it off the inside half of his bat from the crease.
Abbas serves it on a length around leg, Karunaratne gets it off the inside half of his bat through backward square leg for a brace.
Another quick run! On a length outside off, Silva taps it towards covers and sets off for another quick run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. The batsman was safely in though.
Hurled a tad fuller around leg, Karunaratne taps it towards the left of mid on for a single.
Length delivery around off, Silva camps back and plays it towards covers with soft hands. He sets off and gets a quick run.
Amir bowls it full and down the leg side, Dimuth fails to flick and the keeper does the rest.
Another beauty from Amir here! He spears it full outside off, Karunaratne gets beaten yet again as he looks to play that being glued to the crease.
Landed in line of the stumps, Dimuth blocks it off the front foot.

Edged but safe! Karunaratne looks all at sea against Amir here! This is on a length just outside off, he hangs his bat at that. The ball takes the outside edge and flies through the gap between the third slip and gully. He gets two to get off the mark.
Amir hurls it full around off, Silva pushes it towards covers for a single.
Full inswinging delivery on the pads, Silva clips it through backward square leg for a brace.
This is defended off the front foot onto the ground.
A slight delay! The sightscreen was changed thinking it to be the end of the over. So play had to be halted for it to be rectified.
Abbas hurls it around off, Karunaratne defends it off the front foot. A no ball has been signaled as the bowler broke the stumps at his end with his bowling arm as he got into his delivery stride.
This is landed around off and middle, Dimuth blocks it from the crease.
Just short! Abbas bowls it around good length on the pads, Karunaratne clips it. The ball falls agonizingly short of the short leg fielder. Probably the first over is still playing in his mind.
Fuller delivery in line of the stumps, Silva pushes it towards mid-wicket off the front foot and sets off for a run. He gets going in the game.
Abbas bowls it full and very wide of off, Silva doesn't bother playing that.
Starts off with a delivery outside off, Silva responds by shouldering arms to that.
MOHAMMAD ABBAS to share the new ball from the other end. He has three slips, a gully and a short leg in place.

Third time in the over Karunaratne gets beaten! Full outswinging ball outside off, Dimuth pushes at it again. Misses the ball and the keeper collects that. Excellent testing first over to start the game!
And now beaten by the one that comes in! It's bowled on a length around off, Karunaratne pushes at it but the inswing means that he is beaten on the inside this time. Beautiful swing bowling.
Full delivery swinging away from the batsman, Dimuth shoulders arms and lets that go.
Short leg in place now.
This is around off on a fuller length, pushed towards covers off the front foot.
A fuller delivery around off, Karunaratne defends it off the front foot towards point. A hint of movement on that occasion as well.

Beauty straightaway! Amir runs in from over the wicket and spears it on a length just around off. Karunaratne pushes at it from the crease. But the slight movement away means that the ball eludes the edge of the bat. Just!

The weather looks good for a game of cricket. What would be interesting to see is, how the Pink ball would behave under lights. That's for later. For now, the umpires are making their way out to the middle followed by the players. Everybody is set for play. KAUSHAL SILVA and DIMUTH KARUNARATNE are all ready with the bat in hand. MOHAMMAD AMIR will begin the proceedings with the brand new pink cherry! Three slips and a gully in place. Here we go...

Team Changes - One change for Pakistan as WAHAB RIAZ comes in for Hasan Ali. Sri Lanka ring in two changes. SADEERA SAMARAWICKRAMA is handed a Test debut and he will replace Lahiru Thirimanne. Lakshan Sandakan makes way for LAHIRU GAMAGE.
TOSS - Sri Lanka call it right! They win the toss and opt to bat.

Sri Lanka would be delighted at the prospect of winning a Test series away from home after a while. They would miss an experienced Lahiru Thirimanne, who also has been affected by a back injury, increasing the tourists' prospects of playing a debutant for them. Even though Sarfraz Ahmed ruled out their side having any advantage of playing this format earlier, Dinesh Chandimal would know the advantage of acquaintance that sides possess. The visiting skipper also made his intentions of his side going for a win clear. So this game promises to thrill to no ends. Stay tuned with us as an exciting game between bat and ball ensues.

Hello and a warm welcome... well, a rosy welcome to our coverage of the Pink-ball Test! The Dubai International Stadium will be playing host for the second and final game in this series and it is also the venue which hosted the previous day-night Test in the sub-continent. Pakistan would look to give their all, in a bid to win and keep their clean sheet at UAE intact. Apart from that, the ICC rankings are also at stake as the hosts are in danger of slipping down the order to 7th if they end up on the wrong side of the result in this match. As far as the team is concerned, Hasan Ali would be making way for another pacer due to his back troubles.
